practicals.title: Practical-1
content: Make a Flowchart and Algorithm for swap two numbers using
temporary variable and without using temporary variable.

practicals.title: Practical-2
content: Make a Flowchart and Algorithm to represent a bank account
(Contains name of the depositor, account number, type of account
and balance amount in the account) for the process like to deposit an
amount, to withdraw an amount after checking the balance.

practicals.title: Practical-3
content: Write a C program that accepts temperature in Celsius, Fahrenheit,
or Kelvin and converts it into the other two units.

practicals.title: Practical-4
content: Write a program to demonstrate the use of Arithmetic and Bitwise
operators by getting two numbers from the user.

practicals.title: Practical-5
content: Write a program to perform basic arithmetic operations/
mathematical operations like calculators on user inputted data.

practicals.title: Practical-6
content: Write a program that accepts three numbers from the user and print
maximum of them.

practicals.title: Practical-7
content: Write a program to input the Name and the Salary of an Employee.
Calculate and print the Name, Salary and Bonus of the Employee,
where bonus= 5.3% if salary is at least Rs. 10,000 and 6.5%
otherwise.

practicals.title: Practical-8
content: Admission to professional course is subject to the following
conditions. Marks in Mathematics>=60 Marks in Physics>=50
Marks in Chemistry>=40 Total in all three subjects>=200 or total in
mathematics and physics>=150. Assign marks for the three subjects.
Write a program to process the application to list the eligible
candidates.

practicals.title: Practical-9
content: Write a program that accepts two numbers and one code (1,2,3,4)
from the user. According to the code, the operations to be
performed, using switch case statements as follows: (Code: 1?
Addition, 2? Subtraction, 3? Multiplication, 4? Division).

practicals.title: Practical-10
content: Write a program that reads the marks for five subjects of a student.
Calculate and print the grade for the student [i.e. Grade A, B, C, D
and F] using Else-If ladder.

practicals.title: Practical-11
content: Write a program that do sum=1+3+5+……. N terms and
sum=2+4+6+…...... N terms Print value of Sum.

practicals.title: Practical-12
content: Write a program to print the Fibonacci Series [i.e 1,1,2,3,5,8,13…N
terms].

practicals.title: Practical-13
content: Write a program to accept one number from the user. i) Display
reverse of that number. ii) Find if it is Armstrong or not.

practicals.title: Practical-14
content: Write a C program to display different Patterns.

practicals.title: Practical-15
content: Write a program to accept 5 numbers in an array and display it.

practicals.title: Practical-16
content: Write a program to accept 9 numbers twice in form of matrix to
display in matrix form and perform Addition of them.

practicals.title: Practical-17
content: Write a program to accept 5 numbers in array and find maximum
and minimum value of it.

practicals.title: Practical-18
content: Write a program to sort all elements of 1D & 2D array in ascending
and descending order.

practicals.title: Practical-19
content: Calculate the average, geometric and harmonic mean of n elements
in an array.

practicals.title: Practical-20
content: Write a program to calculate and display multiplication of two
matrixes

practicals.title: Practical-21
content: Write a program to count number of vowels in a given string.

practicals.title: Practical-22
content: Write a program to check whether entered string is palindrome or
not

practicals.title: Practical-23
content: Write a program to demonstrate the library function for string.

practicals.title: Practical-24
content: Create a function that converts amount into words. (i.e. 1234: One
Thousand Two Hundred Thirty-Four).

practicals.title: Practical-25
content: Write a program that calculates the factorial of number using both
iterative and recursive functions.

practicals.title: Practical-26
content: Write a function which receives number as argument and return sum
of digit.

practicals.title: Practical-27
content: Write a program to calculate Factorial using recursion in UDF.

practicals.title: Practical-28
content: Write a program to calculate total number of positive, negative and
zero value in array using UDF.

practicals.title: Practical-29
content: Write a program to swap two numbers using UDF and pointer.

practicals.title: Practical-30
content: Write a program using pointer to read in an array of integers and
print its elements in reverse order.

practicals.title: Practical-31
content: Write a C program to create a structure of employees with Full
Name, Last Name, City and Salary. Display it for n employees.

practicals.title: Practical-32
content: Write a program to demonstrate nested structure. (make structures
for circle and rectangle)

practicals.title: Practical-33
content: Write a program to create array of structure. Make a structure for
student having student_no, student_name, student_marks and enter
details for 5 students.

practicals.title: Practical-34
content: Write a program to Display contents of a file on screen. Use
functions (fopen, fclose, getc,putchar,eof)

practicals.title: Practical-35
content: Write a program to count number of characters in a file.
Total Hours 56
